description: Recommend the right icon library for a product from an intent/vibe/platform (e.g. 'minimal SaaS dashboard', 'friendly consumer app with personality', 'iOS app', 'Android Material app', 'dense admin panel'). Returns matched open-source (or platform-native) icon systems with license, install command, coverage, the reason each fits, usage rules, and universal icon best-practices. Deterministic curated guidance — icons are NOT bundled; install the chosen library in your own project. Pair with suggest_font_pairing and generate_color_system.

intent.description: Product vibe / platform / use case, e.g. 'clean developer tool', 'premium fintech app', 'iOS native app', 'Material 3 Android app', 'data-dense dashboard'
